verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Sentry accepting natural-language commands to operate the product. Seer is described as a debugging agent that finds root causes and generates patches, but there is no evidence of a conversational or command interface. The AI-agent setup flow relies on external coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code), and Agent Tracing monitors users' own AI apps; both are adjacent features or user-side tooling, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
